content: PATRON EXITOSO: K8s Cloudflare Tunnel para starter-ia.com. 16 archivos YAML. Single tunnel, 3 ingress (starter-ia.com, www, api). Non-root, drop ALL caps, secretKeyRef, NetworkPolicies. Deploy: kubectl apply -k k8s/

REVIEW COMPLETE: Found 6 issues. CRITICAL: (1) cloudflared configmap has credentials-file reference conflicting with token auth, (2) 5 files missing namespace:starteria, (3) missing www.starter-ia.com route. MEDIUM: (4) cloudflared resources over-provisioned for simple tunnel, (5) backend hardcodes JWT_SECRET and DATABASE_URL passwords inline instead of secretKeyRef, (6) cloudflared image uses latest tag instead of pinned version. PASSED: No LoadBalancer/NodePort/Ingress, all ClusterIP services, deleted files confirmed gone, labels/selectors consistent, postgres not exposed via tunnel, YAML valid.

SIMPLIFIED K8S ARCHITECTURE FOR STARTERIA (starter-ia.com) using Cloudflare Tunnel. NO LoadBalancer, NO Ingress Controller, NO NetworkPolicy. 10 files total: (1) cloudflared-configmap.yaml - tunnel config with ingress rules: starter-ia.com->starteria-frontend:80, api.starter-ia.com->starteria-backend:3001, catch-all->404. (2) cloudflared-deployment.yaml - single replica, cloudflare/cloudflared:latest, token from secret, metrics port 2000. (3) cloudflared-secret.yaml - placeholder token. (4) cloudflared-service.yaml - ClusterIP metrics. (5) frontend-deployment.yaml - nginx on port 80, 1 replica. (6) frontend-service.yaml - ClusterIP port 80. (7) backend-deployment.yaml - Express port 3001, inline env vars (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGIN). (8) backend-service.yaml - ClusterIP port 3001. (9) postgres-statefulset.yaml - postgres:16-alpine, 5Gi PVC, inline creds. (10) postgres-service.yaml - ClusterIP port 5432. REMOVED: network-policy.yaml, kustomization.yaml, namespace.yaml, backend-secrets.yaml, postgres-secrets.yaml. PATTERN: simple labels (app: name), simple ClusterIP services, short service names in configmap (http://starteria-frontend:80), no FQDN, no complex security contexts. DEPLOY: kubectl create ns starteria && kubectl apply -f k8s/ -n starteria

PATRON EXITOSO: K8s simple con Cloudflare Tunnel para Rackspace Spot (sin LB/Ingress). 10 archivos YAML, labels simples (app: name), ClusterIP puro, tunnel outbound, env vars inline. Deploy: kubectl create ns starteria && kubectl apply -f k8s/. Dominios: starter-ia.com, www, api subdomain.
